card.name: Linking words before assessment or monitoring methods
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as per, by, and, at that come right before a named method of assessment or monitoring, like investigator assessment or laboratory follow-up. Seen in drug-label text on monitoring and trial results.

modes.label: per/by before assessment
modes.description: The word per or by introduces who or what measured an outcome.
modes.example: the median progression-free survival (PFS)<< per>> investigator assessment of disease progression was 7

modes.label: and joining monitoring types
modes.description: The word and joins clinical with laboratory follow-up, or estradiol with ultrasound, in monitoring statements.
modes.example: Hepatic function should be monitored closely with both clinical<< and>> laboratory follow-up for at least several months

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that lead into how something is measured or monitored, such as by lab tests or investigator assessment.
